# Simpler Recipes

> Paste any recipe link and get just the recipe — ingredients and steps, no ads, no life story.
> Also a small catalog of clean, ad-free recipes with check-off ingredients, scaling and a hands-free Cook Mode.

## What it does

- Extract: paste any recipe URL on https://www.simpler.recipes/ and get a clean version (JSON-LD/microdata first; an AI fallback only for pages without structured data). Extracted recipes stay on the user's device unless shared.
- Read: /recipes/{slug}/ — one clean recipe page: ingredients (checkable, scalable), instructions, source attribution and a link back to the original.
- Cook Mode: one step at a time, large type, timers, screen stays awake.
- Browse: /collection/{slug}/ (16 curated collections) and /browse/{slug}/ (by ingredient, time and occasion, e.g. /browse/chicken/, /browse/30-minute-dinners/, /browse/vegetarian-dinners/).
- Share: /r/{id} — a shared copy of an extracted recipe (noindex; canonical points to the original source).

## Attribution

Every recipe page credits and links to the site it came from. Simpler Recipes presents a simplified representation; the original publisher owns the recipe.

## Sitemap

https://www.simpler.recipes/sitemap-index.xml

## Public JSON

- GET https://www.simpler.recipes/api/recipes — catalog summaries
- GET https://www.simpler.recipes/api/recipes/{slug} — one recipe
- GET https://www.simpler.recipes/api/recipes/collection/{collection-slug} — a collection
